name: A walk to the café
story: A woman walks along a storefront and arrives at the café doorway.

reviewCriteria.orientation: Composition and action match the shot brief
reviewCriteria.continuity: Subjects, setting and style match the project references
reviewCriteria.crop: Crop preserves the intended subject and action
reviewCriteria.lettering: Caption is accurate, legible and clear of important detail

panels.title: 01 · Walk toward the café
panels.beat: Establish the route. The woman walks left to right along the storefront toward the navy café door. Keep her mustard overshirt, white T-shirt, charcoal trousers, cream sneakers and one tan tote.
panels.caption: 01 / Approach

panels.title: 02 · Continue along the storefront
panels.beat: Continue walking right toward the café. Feet, hips, torso and gaze must agree. Keep the camera on the same side of the pavement, the café door on the right, and the tote in the camera-side hand.
panels.caption: 02 / Continue

versions.label: Direction corrected
versions.prompt: Turn the whole walking pose to the right. Preserve identity, clothing, tote and storefront. Do not mirror the background.

panels.title: 03 · Show the walking detail
panels.beat: Waist-to-feet insert: shoes stride right and the tan tote stays in the trailing camera-side hand. Preserve the trousers, sneakers, pavement and light. Keep the tote and both feet visible.
panels.caption: 03 / Detail

panels.title: 04 · Arrive at the entrance
panels.beat: The woman reaches the navy café entrance on the right. Her body and gaze remain toward the doorway. Keep the table, chairs and planter to its left. Preserve identity, clothes and tote.
panels.caption: 04 / Arrival
